value.text: Correction raised by CodeRabbit on pm-todos#38: the close reason covered two of the three code acceptance criteria and omitted the jsonl object-value parsing one. Verifying it now for the record, at index.ts around line 1230: each jsonl line is JSON.parse'd inside a try/catch that raises a usage error naming the line number, then guarded by isRecord so a non-object line is rejected with expected a JSON object rather than crashing, and every field is individually type-guarded (typeof parsed.title === string, and the same for description, type, status and the other optional passthroughs). An object value landing in a scalar field is therefore ignored safely instead of being coerced. The criterion holds; only the close reason was incomplete. Original record preserved rather than rewritten.
